{{Nihongo|'''Katsuhiko Ariga'''|有賀克彦|Ariga Katsuhiko|born 1962}} is a Japanese chemist specializing in [[nanotechnology]] and [[self-assembly]]. He was educated at the [[Tokyo Institute of Technology]], where he defended his PhD in 1990 and later worked as assistant professor. Since 2004 he carries out research at the [[National Institute for Materials Science]], and teaches at the [[University of Tokyo]], where he is a full professor. Ariga is a [[Fellow of the Royal Society of Chemistry]] (2013)<ref name=cv3/> and an editor of the journal ''[[Science and Technology of Advanced Materials]]''.<ref name=stam/>

==Selected publications==
According to the [[Web of Science]] Ariga published five articles with more than 700 citations each:

* {{cite journal|doi=10.1021/ja00127a026|title=Assembly of Multicomponent Protein Films by Means of Electrostatic Layer-by-Layer Adsorption|journal=Journal of the American Chemical Society|volume=117|issue=22|pages=6117–6123|year=1995|last1=Lvov|first1=Yuri|last2=Ariga|first2=Katsuhiko|last3=Ichinose|first3=Izumi|last4=Kunitake|first4=Toyoki}}
* {{cite journal|doi=10.1039/b700410a|pmid=17492095|title=Layer-by-layer assembly as a versatile bottom-up nanofabrication technique for exploratory research and realistic application|journal=Physical Chemistry Chemical Physics|volume=9|issue=19|pages=2319–40|year=2007|last1=Ariga|first1=Katsuhiko|last2=Hill|first2=Jonathan P.|last3=Ji|first3=Qingmin|bibcode=2007PCCP....9.2319A}}
* {{cite journal|doi=10.1246/bcsj.20110162|title=Nanoarchitectonics for Mesoporous Materials|journal=Bulletin of the Chemical Society of Japan|volume=85|pages=1–32|year=2012|last1=Ariga|first1=Katsuhiko|last2=Vinu|first2=Ajayan|last3=Yamauchi|first3=Yusuke|last4=Ji|first4=Qingmin|last5=Hill|first5=Jonathan P.|doi-access=free}}
* {{cite journal|doi=10.1246/cl.130987|title=Layer-by-layer Nanoarchitectonics: Invention, Innovation, and Evolution|journal=Chemistry Letters|volume=43|pages=36–68|year=2014|last1=Ariga|first1=Katsuhiko|last2=Yamauchi|first2=Yusuke|last3=Rydzek|first3=Gaulthier|last4=Ji|first4=Qingmin|last5=Yonamine|first5=Yusuke|last6=Wu|first6=Kevin C.-W.|last7=Hill|first7=Jonathan P.}}
* {{cite journal|doi=10.1088/1468-6996/9/1/014109|pmid=27877935|title=Challenges and breakthroughs in recent research on self-assembly|journal=Science and Technology of Advanced Materials|volume=9|issue=1|article-number=014109|year=2008|last1=Ariga|first1=Katsuhiko|last2=Hill|first2=Jonathan P.|last3=Lee|first3=Michael V.|last4=Vinu|first4=Ajayan|last5=Charvet|first5=Richard|last6=Acharya|first6=Somobrata|pmc=5099804}}
